text: Synchronous /decide endpoint reviews an order for fraud right after checkout and returns a decision immediately
quote: The `/decide` endpoint is used to request that Riskified review an order for fraud after the customer has input their payment data and completed the purchase... Riskified's decision is returned synchronously

text: /submit endpoint sends transaction data post-authorization and returns the fraud decision asynchronously via a notification URL
quote: The `/submit` endpoint sends transaction data to Riskified after the gateway authorizes the transaction for fraud analysis... the fraud decision is returned via your pre-configured notification URL

text: Advise endpoint gives a synchronous decision for clear fraud, plus CVV/3DS and TRA/SCA exemption recommendations
quote: For each order reviewed by advise we provide a synchronous decision if it is clear fraud... CVV/3DS recommendations can be provided... TRA/SCA exemption recommendation is added for the regulated markets

text: Fully automated chargeback gateway integrations with Braintree, Stripe, Adyen, and PayPal handle chargeback reporting and disputing end-to-end
quote: Riskified offers fully automated chargeback gateway integrations for major gateways: Braintree, Stripe, Adyen, PayPal; this process automates end-to-end chargeback handling from chargeback reporting to the disputing process

text: Official SDKs are provided in multiple languages, though using the raw HTTP API directly is also supported
quote: Riskified provides SDKs for several languages to simplify API integration. SDK usage is optional, and all API endpoints can also be accessed directly using HTTP requests.

text: Beacon is a JavaScript snippet embedded on the merchant site that collects data needed to assess order legitimacy
quote: Riskfied's Beacon is a JavaScript snippet that merchants embed on their website. It collects fundamental data required to decide on the legitimacy of an order.

text: Requests include an HMAC-SHA256 signature computed from the POST body and the merchant's auth token for verification
quote: X-RISKIFIED-HMAC-SHA256 | Verification hash for the Request. Generated by performing an SHA256 encryption on the request's POST body and calculating the HMAC hash of the result using your Riskified authentication token.

text: Automated approve/decline decision notifications are pushed to a merchant-defined webhook endpoint, with retries on non-2xx responses
quote: Riskified can send automated decision notifications to a merchant-defined endpoint when an order is approved or declined... If the endpoint responds with a non-2xx HTTP status code, Riskified retries delivery

text: A customer-authentication API triggered on login/account events returns an allow, notify, or challenge decision
quote: API is triggered only for customer-initiated authentication requests, e.g., user tries to login to their account... `decision` field will be set as one of the following values: `allow`, `notify`, or `challenge`.

text: A dedicated Agentforce Commerce (Salesforce Commerce Cloud) fraud protection cartridge provides platform-tailored integration
quote: Agentforce Commerce (formerly Salesforce Commerce Cloud / SFCC) fraud protection cartridge provides a structured integration process tailored to SFCC's platform architecture.

text: Post-decision automation voids authorization, restocks inventory, captures funds, and sends cancellation emails based on the fraud decision
quote: Voids authorization on orders declined by Riskified. Enables automatic restocking of orders declined by Riskified. Captures funds for orders approved by Riskified.

text: Onboarding includes vendor-led data validation and model calibration on the merchant's shop flows before going live
quote: If we have questions about shop flows or encounter data issues, we will reach out to you for clarification... Once data validation passes, your account is handed over to our analytics team who will be transferring and calibrating the models

text: A dedicated endpoint lets merchants notify Riskified that a chargeback has been filed for an order
quote: Notifies Riskified that a chargeback has been submitted for a specific order.

text: A JavaScript function retrieves a session ID for tying browsing/checkout sessions into the fraud decision
quote: To get the session-ID, use the JavaScript function `RISKX.getSessionId()`.

text: A Shopify app installation kicks off a guided integration process, mostly handled by the Riskified team
quote: Once you have installed the Riskified app in your Shopify store, the integration process can begin. During this time, most of the “heavy lifting” will be done by the Riskified team.

text: Supports pre-authorization synchronous, post-authorization synchronous, and post-authorization asynchronous integration/review modes
quote:
Riskified supports different integration types:
- **Pre-authorization Synchronous**: Review orders before payment authorization
- **Post-authorization Synchronous**: Review orders after payment authorization with synchronous response
